messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: algebraic optimization certifying area lower bounds via semidefinite relaxation

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal configuration of 13 points in the unit square for the largest minimum triangle area is given by a specific set of coordinates, all expressible over the degree-12 number field adjoining √13, √3, and √(2+√3); the maximum achievable minimum area equals exactly (13√3-21)/52 ≈ 0.00900454. A semidefinite relaxation over the 26-dimensional coordinate vector, with a rank-1 completion, certifies the area lower bound by enclosing all C(13,3)=286 triangle areas within a positive-semidefinite Gram matrix constraint."}
